missions.title: First Flow
missions.briefing: Raise three runoff barriers, recover the marked wreckage, and protect the beacon while the dam fills.
missions.field_guide: Raise each runoff barrier, then watch the beacon alert while the far-side dam fills.
missions.objective: Guide 6,000 vU of meltwater into the far-side restoration dam.

missions.title: The Holding Line
missions.briefing: Recover local fabrication, bootstrap the aquifer pump from geothermal power, and hold the camp through the surge.
missions.field_guide: Watch the alert level. The source surges at tick 900; reservoirs retain water and spillways shed excess.
missions.objective: Hold 6,000–9,000 vU in the restoration trench and survive the forecast surge.

missions.title: Firebreak Protocol
missions.briefing: Meter finite cistern water into lava, capture the steam, and power the relay before the ancient foundation is reached.
missions.field_guide: Bring water to lava deliberately: their reaction creates the rock barrier. Keep lava away from the foundation.
missions.objective: Form 3,000 vU of rock on the reaction shelf and sustain the powered relay.

prompts.title: WELCOME
prompts.instruction: Survey the ash basin and dismiss this briefing.

prompts.title: CAMERA
prompts.instruction: Adjust the survey view to inspect the ridge.

prompts.title: SURVEY CURSOR
prompts.instruction: Position the survey cursor on a terrain cell.
prompts.action: Tap a terrain cell on the map

prompts.title: INSPECT
prompts.instruction: Inspect the selected cell before changing it.
prompts.action: Tap INSPECT in FIELD TOOLS, then DISMISS

prompts.title: FABRICATION CACHE
prompts.instruction: Select the marked wreckage cache to inspect its recoverable stock.

prompts.title: RECOVER STOCK
prompts.instruction: Recover the one-shot cache; its fabU enters the field ledger exactly once.

prompts.title: PAUSE AND PLAN
prompts.instruction: Pause the simulation before changing the terrain.
prompts.action: Tap PAUSE in the time controls at right

prompts.title: FIRST BARRIER
prompts.instruction: Raise the first runoff cut at (8, 10) to block the fissure.

prompts.title: REMAINING BARRIERS
prompts.instruction: Raise the two remaining runoff cuts so water stays in the eastbound course.
prompts.action: Tap each target, then tap RAISE

prompts.title: CHANNEL PLAN
prompts.instruction: Queue and commit a channel at the marked saddle before running water.

prompts.title: OBSERVE
prompts.instruction: Run time and watch water cross the map toward the dam.
prompts.action: Tap 1X in the time controls at right

prompts.title: BEACON WARNING
prompts.instruction: Inspect the advisory warning before changing the inlet gate.
prompts.action: Tap INSPECT and read the warning

prompts.title: OPEN THE INLET
prompts.instruction: Open the floodgate fully during the grace period to protect the beacon.
prompts.action: Tap FULL in the flow controls

prompts.title: STABILIZE
prompts.instruction: Keep time running while the far-side dam fills and verifies.
prompts.action: Tap 1X and watch the DAM objective readout

prompts.title: GRID READOUT
prompts.instruction: Inspect the field readout before placing powered equipment.

prompts.title: BOOTSTRAP PUMP
prompts.instruction: Connect the aquifer pump to the geothermal power source.

prompts.title: POWER LOOP
prompts.instruction: Place a flow turbine on the routed water path.
prompts.action: Place and commit a FLOW TURBINE

prompts.title: GENERATION
prompts.instruction: Run time and observe the power ledger respond.

prompts.title: DEMAND
prompts.instruction: Keep powered devices online while the surge passes.
